name: Good Room
status_note: Official calendar lists Good Room / Bad Room parties most Thu–Sat from 10/22 through 12/18/2026 (plus 2/9/2027), ticketed via Resident Advisor. Note: the official site's SSL certificate had expired on 2026-10-18 (browsers may show a warning). A Time Out listing calling it 'currently closed' appears stale.

dress.detail: The official site lists no dress code and calls the club an open, inclusive space; The Infatuation (2018) says there is no dress code and no bouncer judging who gets in outside ticketed events.

cover.value: Ticketed per party; a recent RA listing was $10–20

getting_in.value: Buy tickets through the Resident Advisor links on the official calendar; entry screening at ticketed events

sources.name: Good Room calendar (official, links to RA)

hours.value: Party nights mostly Thu–Sat (occasional Sun/Tue); a recent RA listing ran 10pm–4am

skip_if: You want conversation: reviewers describe very loud house music in a mini-warehouse club setting.
You want a non-ticketed drop-in: most nights are ticketed RA parties, so check the calendar first.
